I also told her that Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01, so her QBR deck doesn't show an out-of-date number.

- **Where the figures come from:** gbrain's copies of the amendments and the account page. I couldn't open the contract file through the shared files: the path I tried wasn't found, and no contract files showed up in the file list.
- **Why it was OK to share:** seat counts and dates count as account facts, not finance figures. Dana also owns the account and is on the North team. I didn't include any prices.
